name: Generate c# Code
description: Generate a C# class with given specifications.
template:
Write a C# class named `{class_name}` that {description}.
Requirements:
{requirements}
Output the code in a markdown code block with the filename as `{function_name}.py`.

defaults.requirements:
- Use file-scoped namespaces
- Include XML documentation
- Implement error handling
- Follow .NET 10 best practices
- Use modern C# features
-Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
- For each file, output its content in a markdown code block with the filename as the language specifier.
